input.quote: (b) Licensee agrees to allow an independent Certified Public Accountant or other Audit Professional, (selected by mutual agreement) to audit and analyze appropriate accounting records to ensure compliance with all terms of this Agreement. Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor.
input.rationale: The only audit right binding us (Article IV(b)) is unlimited in frequency: Licensor may demand audits as often as it likes, and the 30-day reference is a deadline for us to permit the audit rather than advance notice, so the clause fails even the fallback (once per year on 15 days' notice) and sits in walk-away territory for unlimited audits. Cost allocation already meets the preferred position (Licensor bears cost unless a discrepancy over 5% is found) and the auditor is already an independent CPA/Audit Professional, so we have taken the preferred level and added only the missing frequency, notice, business-hours, off-site, auditor confidentiality and no-system-access limits.

mappings.element: Vendor may audit no more than once in any 12-month period.
Vendor must give at least 30 days' written notice of an audit.
Audits are conducted by an independent auditor.
mappings.quote: Licensee agrees to allow an independent Certified Public Accountant or other Audit Professional, (selected by mutual agreement) to audit and analyze appropriate accounting records

mappings.element: The auditor is bound by confidentiality obligations.
Audits are conducted off-site where possible.
Vendor bears audit costs unless underpayment exceeds 5 percent.
mappings.quote: The cost of the audit will be borne by Licensor unless a discrepancy of more than five-percent (5%) is discovered, in which case the cost of the audit shall be borne by Licensee.

mappings.element: Vendor has no direct access to Customer systems for an audit.

proposal.summary: Limit audit frequency and notice and add business-hours, off-site, confidentiality and no-system-access protections
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We capped audits at one per 12-month period on 30 days' prior written notice, and added business-hours, off-site, auditor confidentiality and no-system-access limits; the existing independent auditor and Licensor-cost/5% provisions are unchanged.

ops.oldText: Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor.
ops.newText: Licensor may request such an audit no more than once in any 12-month period, on at least 30 days' prior written notice to Licensee.

ops.text: Each such audit shall be conducted during Licensee's normal business hours and off-site wherever possible, by an auditor bound by confidentiality obligations, and Licensor shall have no direct access to Licensee's systems.
